text:
miko_docs: heads up  small nitpick pass: we have several docs that use different capitalizations for feature flags: 'feature flag', 'Feature flag', 'FeatureFlag'. Proposing a tiny style rule and a quick tidy.

rahul_devex: agreed, that's noisy in code samples. what's your proposed rule?

miko_docs: rule: use lowercase 'feature flag' in prose; use `feature_flag` snake_case for config/env variables; use `FeatureFlag` PascalCase only when referencing a type/class. Add glossary entry.

eva_engineering: will need a sweep through infra docs and examples. some Terraform snippets use `feature_flag` var names already, but some use camelCase.

miko_docs: plan: I'll make a meta PR that lists files, then small PRs per area. I'll exclude release notes and legal.

cicd-bot: Meta PR #499 opened by miko_docs. CI started.

nora_prod: marketing: we don't need a release note for this, but please add a short mention in docs changelog so users see terminology clarified.

rahul_devex: sample sed for variable rename in code samples (careful):
rg "FeatureFlag|featureFlag|feature_flag" docs | sed -n '1,120p'
# replace only in code blocks
# manual review recommended

eva_engineering: I'll help with the terraform/examples dirs. Also will run the snippet test harness.

miko_docs: assigned tasks in meta PR: miko docs core, rahul SDKs, eva infra/examples, nora release blurb.

cicd-bot: CI passed for #499.

miko_docs: merging tracking PR now. follow-ups incoming.

rahul_devex: opened SDK PRs to normalize variable names in examples; seeing one failing doctest that references camelCase var name, will patch tests.

eva_engineering: updated terraform examples; added note in the example readme about variable naming.

nora_prod: added changelog bullet to the docs changelog.

miko_docs: closing the loop: everything merged except one small test fix in sdk-python. Leaving this thread open until that lands.

rahul_devex: sdk-python test fix PR merged. all green.

miko_docs: great, thanks! :tada:
